strings.text:
🤖 Review preview: proposed awake-time allowances

A Free account includes 60 awake hours a month. This is one monthly pool, not a daily two-hour quota.

Personal includes 100 awake hours a month. That is the base-band allowance; paid allowances vary by billing country.

strings.text:
Proposed overages behavior

Overages are usage beyond your included allowances, billed at the published rates.

Paid overages would be off by default. You could enable them during signup or later in account settings.
strings.original:
Proposed overages behavior

Overages are usage beyond your included allowances, billed at the published rates.

Paid overages would be off by default. You could enable them during signup or later in account settings.

strings.text:
Proposed always-awake behavior

Apps normally sleep after they are idle and wake when someone visits. Sleeping time does not use your awake allowance.

To keep an app awake 24/7, you would enable overages and choose Always awake for that app. An estimate would be shown before you enable it.

Always-awake controls and overage opt-in are still being built.

strings.text: These examples use proposed USD rates for country band A and assume a 730-hour average month, one app, no awake time from other apps, and a team minimum of 10 members. Subscriptions are paid annually. The monthly figures are comparisons only.
strings.original: These examples use proposed USD rates for country band A and assume a 730-hour average month, one app, no awake time from other apps, and a team minimum of 10 members. Subscriptions are paid annually. The monthly figures are comparisons only.

strings.text: Storage, data transfer, replication writes, and taxes are excluded. The actual bill depends on the month length and other usage.
strings.original: Storage, data transfer, replication writes, and taxes are excluded. The actual bill depends on the month length and other usage.

strings.text:
Plan Example
Personal 630 excess hours × $0.012 = $7.56/month, plus $28/year. Monthly equivalent: $9.89.
Community, 10 members 560 excess hours × $0.012 = $6.72/month, plus $60/year. Monthly equivalent: $11.72.
Business, 10 members 1,700 included hours. No compute overage in this example. $600/year, or $50/month equivalent.

strings.text: Free cannot keep one app awake continuously because it includes only 60 awake hours a month.

strings.text:
Pricing status

The USD and GBP overage rates are proposals, not approved prices. These examples are for private review and are not final pricing.
